subject: social_studies
concept: Applying multiple ethical frameworks to the same real-world dilemma and comparing the different conclusions each reaches
source_inspiration: original content, following the Education Conduct Policy's evenhandedness principle — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student maps a single dilemma against outcome-based, rule-based, and virtue-based reasoning side by side
exercise.abstract: Student analyzes a real-world ethical dilemma from three different ethical frameworks and compares the conclusions

assessment.mastery_threshold: genuinely applies all three frameworks distinctly rather than reaching the same reasoning three times
misconception_flags: applies the same underlying reasoning to all three 'different' framework analyses without real distinction

interest_binding: dilemma generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
